// Download represents the Download data structure.
type Download struct {
	Size int64         `json:"size"`
	Body io.ReadCloser `json:"body"`
}

// Upload represents the Upload data structure.
type Upload struct {
	Name string        `json:"name"`
	Body io.ReadCloser `json:"body"`
}

// wireDownload is the wire form of Download: streams travel as handles.
type wireDownload struct {
	Size int64  `json:"size"`
	Body uint32 `json:"body"`
}

func downloadFromWire(w wireDownload) Download {
	return Download{
		Size: w.Size,
		Body: stream.Reader(w.Body),
	}
}

func downloadPtrFromWire(w *wireDownload) *Download {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}
	v := downloadFromWire(*w)
	return &v
}

func downloadToWire(v Download) (wireDownload, error) {
	var w wireDownload
	var err error
	w.Size = v.Size
	if w.Body, err = stream.HandleOf(v.Body); err != nil {
		return wireDownload{}, err
	}
	return w, nil
}

func downloadPtrToWire(v *Download) (*wireDownload, error) {
	if v == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	w, err := downloadToWire(*v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &w, nil
}
